cover_empty: No milestones yet. Plan the first cut
empty_hint: A milestone is the cut that turns endless development into a shippable deliverable. Name the first one.
certify_cut_tooltip: Certify the cut. Stamps the scope-creep baseline
certify_ship_tooltip: Every criterion reads GO. Ship it
certify_blocked_tooltip: Blocked until every exit criterion reads GO
dispatch_gap_tooltip: Dispatch a Fleet session at this gap
cut_empty_planner: No cut yet. Promote from the ledger below, or open the composer.
cut_empty_has_brief: Nothing in the cut yet, and this project has no goals or features to promote — but the objective above has a brief. Decompose it into goals to fill the cut.
cut_empty_nothing: Nothing in the cut, and nothing to promote — this project has no goals and no features yet. Write a brief under the objective and decompose it, or open Compose scope to chart the features.
outside_the_cut_aside: the row's buttons are the decision
outside_empty_no_features: No features mapped yet. Open Compose scope to chart the project and add the first ones.
certify_criteria_summary: {met} of {total} exit criteria met — the evidence for each is on the milestone behind this dialog.
crit_skill_coverage_evidence: {covered} of {total} contexts in the cut carry fresh skill insight — {skills}.
crit_skill_coverage_none: No skill has left insight on this project in the last 30 days, so there is nothing to measure coverage against yet.
crit_skill_coverage_empty: The cut has no contexts, so there is no code for a skill to have covered.
crit_contexts_empty: No core scope yet. Compose the cut first
crit_kpi_empty: Coverage derives once the cut has members
crit_kpi_evidence: {covered} of {total} core contexts carry an active KPI
crit_objective_empty: Bind a measurable goal from the composer
crit_sensors_missing: Bind monitoring / LLM connectors in Observability
crit_scope_uncut: Not cut yet. Creep tracking starts at the cut
crit_scope_clean: Nothing joined the cut after certification
velocity_no_history: No cycle-time history yet. Two shipped milestones make a forecast possible.
velocity_typical: Typical cycle: {days} days from cut to ship, across {count} shipped
goal_assist_tooltip: Dispatch an agent to categorize / execute this goal
the_cut_aside: every row pulled its contexts into the footprint above
cut_empty_unscanned: The cut fills from the library. Chart the codebase first.
cut_empty_scanned: Empty cut. Add features from the library.
drawer_features_empty: No features slice this context yet. Quick-add one from the library tree.
drawer_goals_empty: No goals attached to this context.
dispatch_crit_hint: The brief below spawns a Dev-runner session in the project repo. Edit it before dispatching if needed.
seed_milestone_goal: The project is fully onboarded: passport assessed, first sensors bound, scaffolding ready for milestone-driven shipping.
seed_goal_description: Seeded when "Onboard with Fleet" was dispatched. Done when the guided onboarding session has assessed the passport dimensions and bound the first sensors.
goal_placeholder: What does shipping this milestone deliver?
note_placeholder: Why is this in the cut?
duality_conflict: Your rating and the automated reading point different ways here.
duality_advisory: Your ratings are reported here for comparison only. They never change the ship verdict or the progress bar, which derive from the exit criteria.
run_milestone_tooltip: Open a Claude Code session that executes this cut with /ship-milestone, then bring its result back with Ingest run.
run_ingest_tooltip: Read the newest finished run and apply its per-item notes and ratings. Refused rather than half-applied if the result is malformed.
run_ingest_counts: {updated} item(s) updated · {ratings} rating(s) · {descriptions} description(s) · {reported} reported unchanged
run_proposed_hint: The run suggests these; nothing was added. Add them yourself from the composer if you agree.
ask_athena_tooltip: Open Athena with this milestone in front of her — its cut, its blockers and what is still outside it — and shape the scope in conversation
compose_scope_tooltip: Pick which features and goals make up this milestone
certify_cut_intro: Cutting freezes the scope: anything that joins after this is marked as scope creep. The exit criteria below are measured against the cut, so they do not block making one.
certify_ship_intro: These criteria, and only these, decide whether this milestone can ship. Every line is derived from live signals — nothing here is typed in.
description_placeholder: What shipping this milestone actually means
goals_rail_empty: No goals yet — write one and Athena will place it
description_editor_hint: Ctrl+B for bold · start a line with “- ” for a list
decompose_brief_tooltip: Ask Athena to read this milestone’s brief and propose the goals it names. Nothing is created until you confirm her card.
decompose_brief_no_brief: This milestone has no brief yet. Write what shipping it means, then decompose that.
